newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Travel seen in HK$1.6 bln placement.
newsitem.headline: China Travel seen in HK$1.6 bln placement.

text.p: China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Ltd is expected to issue 455 million new shares to raise over HK$1.6 billion for assets acquistions, market sources said on Monday.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.

Sources said China Travel International's parent, China Travel Service (Holdings) Hong Kong Ltd, is expected to place 455 million existing shares at HK$3.60 per share, after which the parent will subscribe for the same amount of new shares.
The funds raised are expected to be used for the purchase of assets including toll roads, power plants and a stake in an airline from the parent.
Trading in the company's shares were suspended on Monday afternoon at its own request pending an announcement.
